issue_request: Published/Persuasive STU3 issue asking that implementation guides identify their sponsoring work group, preferably on the landing page; the accepted resolution specified ImplementationGuide.publisher as "HL7 International - <workgroup name>", ImplementationGuide.contact as the work group homepage, and adding those rules to the HL7 IG guide quality criteria.

additional_context: Current Confluence publication requirements say all FHIR IGs SHALL declare publisher/contact and expose them from the home page, and that HL7-published IGs shall use the HL7 work group publisher/contact form. ImplementationGuide is active in core, but publisher/contact remain optional base metadata because the stricter rule is HL7 publication policy/tooling rather than universal FHIR resource semantics. The related enforcement issue FHIR-19632 is already represented on the combined branch.
